prompts.prompt: This branch only changes three Markdown guides. Review every changed document before I push.
prompts.expected_behavior: Builds immutable scope, performs citation pre-pass, dispatches two byte-identical whole-artifact reviewer arms, unions findings across five dimensions, and mints only a valid docs-owned PASS marker.

prompts.prompt: Only review these Markdown changes and tell me what is wrong. Do not edit anything.
prompts.expected_behavior: Classifies the request as review-only, reports instruction and evidence findings, and makes no artifact changes.

prompts.prompt: You already reviewed the docs once and found a blocking ambiguity. I edited it; run another full review, auto-fix anything else, and keep looping until clean.
prompts.expected_behavior: Uses only one bounded delta confirmation, applies deterministic in-scope fixes because this is an authorized change task, and treats STILL_BLOCKING as a quality diagnosis rather than asking for another authorization batch.
